coverage_note: All photos used on the Asia continent page (/continents/asia) and the Asia card of the /continents hub. Licence, author and dimensions were verified via the Wikimedia Commons API (imageinfo extmetadata) for each exact file on 2026-11-04, one call at a time. The width/height/sha1 below describe the Commons originals; the site serves 1280px WebP derivatives stored in public/images/continents/. Every derivative was viewed before wiring: subjects are complete and recognisable (Great Wall winding whole over the hills, Everest's full summit pyramid, the Dead Sea's water and shore, the Yangtze flowing through a gorge, Tokyo Skytree complete from base to spire with Mount Fuji behind, the Registan's three madrasas whole, Angkor Wat's five towers whole with their reflection).
